name: svg-mask
blurb: SVG mask that reveals content underneath as you hover and move the cursor.
description: A two-layer reveal component using SVG masking. Mask grows from small to large on hover and follows cursor position to reveal the content layer.
use_when: An interactive hero section or content reveal where hover interaction guides attention.
avoid_when: On mobile or touch devices — no pointer to track. Requires external SVG mask asset.
a11y: Both layers are in DOM but mask obscures one. No keyboard control over reveal timing.
